title: Implication if Civil Servants Use ChatGPT to Write Reports and Speeches
what_it_is: Implication if Civil Servants Use ChatGPT to Write Reports and Speeches

sections.label: Pair writing tool for civil servants
sections.summary: The Government will pilot Pair with agencies, keep Government information confidential via an Azure OpenAI agreement, and civil servants remain responsible for policy decisions and document content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: One such effort is the development of Pair, in which we see potential in helping civil servants with parts of the writing process, such as summarising long reference material, exploring related ideas, or improving the clarity of writing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Government aims to pilot this with a number of agencies and will carefully evaluate the results before determining how best to roll it out to the broader civil service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: To ensure data security, the Government has struck an agreement with Azure OpenAI, the large language model provider, for Government information to remain confidential.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In addition to these technical safeguards, work that contains highly confidential or sensitive information will still be written exclusively by civil servants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Ultimately, civil servants using the tool are still directly responsible for making policy decisions, as well as crafting, refining and customising the content of documents to ensure that they are relevant, accurate and appropriate.

sections.label: Redeployment and productivity tools experience
sections.summary: Past use of productivity and automation tools led to redeveloped job roles and tasks rather than redeployment, though the effect of this tool is still unknown.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The second question about redeployment, our experience in other parts of Government, with the use of productivity enhancement tools or automation, has resulted not in redeployment of personnel, so much as redevelopment of job roles and the tasks that officers are engaged in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This has been our experience for a number of years across the number of Ministries and agencies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It remains to be seen what the effect will be of this tool, as I said, it is early days yet.
